description: This file defines a class named HTMLPurifier_Filter_YouTube which extends the HTMLPurifier_Filter class. The class provides methods to process HTML content to embed or transform YouTube videos, including pre-filtering to detect embed code, post-filtering to replace shortcodes or spans with embedded objects, and utility methods for URL handling.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Filter_YouTube
classes.description: A filter class for processing YouTube embeds within HTML content, providing pre-processing and post-processing methods to handle YouTube embed code and shortcodes.

methods.name: preFilter
methods.description: Processes input HTML to convert YouTube object embeds into span tags with a specific class for later processing.

methods.name: postFilter
methods.description: Post-processing method that converts span tags back into embedded object code for YouTube videos.

methods.name: armorUrl
methods.description: Sanitizes and modifies YouTube URLs to prevent security issues or formatting conflicts.

methods.name: postFilterCallback
methods.description: Callback method used during post-filtering to generate the embed object HTML for the YouTube URL.
